name: RadioGroup
description: A group container for Radio components. Renders a <fieldset> with a <legend> for accessible grouping. Provides name, selected value, onChange, and disabled state to child Radio components via context. Implements arrow key navigation per the ARIA radio group pattern.

notes: Uses a native <fieldset> with role=radiogroup and a <legend> for accessible group labelling.
Arrow keys (Up/Down/Left/Right) cycle focus and selection through enabled radio options.
Tab moves focus into and out of the group; only the selected (or first) radio is in the tab order.
Disabled radio items are skipped during arrow key navigation.
The onChange callback receives the string value of the newly selected radio.

legend.description: The accessible label for the group. Rendered as a <legend>. Required.

name.description: The name attribute shared by all Radio inputs in the group. Must be unique on the page.

onChange.description: Called when the selected value changes. Receives the new string value.

direction.description: Layout direction of the radio items. 'vertical' stacks them; 'horizontal' places them in a row.

disabled.description: Disables all Radio children in the group.

children.description: Radio components to render inside the group.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the fieldset element.

do: Always provide a legend prop for accessible grouping.
Provide a unique name prop to associate radios with the same group.
Use RadioGroup for mutually exclusive choices.
Handle the onChange to update the controlled value.
dont: Do not use RadioGroup for non-exclusive choices — use CheckboxGroup instead.
Do not omit the legend — it is required for accessibility.
